main.description: Puts a scope in an organization, or takes it out. With 'organization', asks for the scope's 'dev.zena-lang.scope.organization' record naming it, which the registry holds until the 'ownerThreshold' of the scope's owners and the 'ownerThreshold' of the organization's owners have both attested it, and 'dev.zena-lang.registry.completeChange' writes it; the caller must be an owner of one of them. Without, deletes the record at once; the caller must be an owner of the scope or of the organization it names.

scope.description: The scope, by its DID, on this registry.

organization.description: The organization to put the scope in, by its DID. Absent, the scope leaves its organization.

swapRecord.description: The CID the record must have now; the write fails with 'InvalidSwap' otherwise.

cid.description: With 'organization', the new record's CID, which an attestation names.

errors.name: NotInOrganization
errors.description: Without 'organization': the scope belongs to no organization.
